feeds.title: My Spiced Life
feeds.description: My name is Jennifer. Spiced Beauty is my Spiced Life: Beauty, fashion & Lifestyle Blog. I started this blog not only for Black women in Canada but for anyone that just wants to try something new. In 2018, I gave birth to a beautiful baby girl and will continue to share my experiences on this blog.

feeds.title: Jamila Kyari Blog
feeds.description: JamilaKyari.com is an African fashion and lifestyle brand that inspires women to live a colourful, vibrant and bold life. It achieves this through the showcase of bright colours, vibrant prints and bold patterns in women's apparel, home decor, stationery and gifts. Content includes style posts, product reviews and lifestyle tips tricks with an African twist.

feeds.title: Beckerman Blog
feeds.description: A Daily Fashion Blog that chronicles the Beckerman Sisters and their adventures on planet earth.

feeds.description: Canadian lifestyle blogger and fashion enthusiast. Covering beauty, food and interior decoration.

feeds.title: Krystin Tysire
feeds.description: I am Krystin Tysire. My blog specializes in a look enabling me to share my passion for fashion: fit, trendy and sporty, ready to enjoy the grand Vancouver scenery whether sunny, rainy or in-between or which look I want to portray: glam, sporty, student, work, or evening out with friends. The fashions and accessories I feature can easily go from work to life to adventure.

feeds.title: Playing With Apparel
feeds.description: With her love of fashion, Filipa created her blog, 'Playing With Apparel' as an outlet to express her thoughts and ideas. She continues to write articles on various fashion/beauty products and trends while managing to feature her sometimes quirky and forever-changing personal style.

feeds.title: Dress To Kill Canadian Fashion Magazine
feeds.description: Dress to kill is a fashion magazine raised in montreal and distributed across notrh America. Featuring innovative and creative images, Dress to Kill Magazine profiles the best in fashion, beauty, art, design and music of the moment.

feeds.description: A visual diary where Jill Lansky shares her expert style tips and tricks, the latest trends, easy beauty tutorials, and travel guides. She empowers her readers to become the best version of themselves and use clothing as a means to gain confidence.

feeds.description: The Urban Umbrella is a Vancouver Style, Beauty and Fashion blog by Bree Aylwin, for the every girl who loves style on a budget. feeds.title: Alicia Fashionista
feeds.description: Alicia Fashionista is a place for the everywoman who loves to travel, sees beauty in the ordinary, and believes that confidence is the best accessory.

feeds.title: La Petite Noob
feeds.description: A fashion and lifestyle blog situated in Toronto, Ontario, Canada discussing personal style, fashion, beauty and culture.

feeds.title: Bobby Raffin
feeds.description: This a fashion and lifestyle blog by Bobby Rafin.

feeds.title: Alexander Kenton Liang
feeds.description: Alexander Liang is a style and travel blogger, entrepreneur. This is a blog of his life and style.

feeds.title: Krystin Lee
feeds.description: Since its first post in 2012, Krystin Lee has become a daily destination for women with varied interests in fashion, home decor, beauty, and travel. My hope is to inspire you as I share my journey and I encourage you to join in on the adventure! I simply saw blogging as a means to share my creativity through an outlet. I could have never imagined it would come so far!

feeds.title: Gumboot Glam
feeds.description: Hello, I am Ally GradleyI've always been inspired by fashion, style and beauty. From a young age, I also relished being in front of a camera. With a desire to channel my passion, and with only a shoestring budget, I founded Gumboot Glam, to share my styling's, and musings on beauty, health and fitness.

feeds.title: THE PREP GUY
feeds.description: The Prep Guy is a men's fashion and lifestyle blog created by Canada's leading plus-size male model, Syed Sohail. We are a men's fashion and lifestyle destination for Modern Canadian and American males. It focuses on providing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, grooming, and self-confidence advice for men of all shapes and body types.

feeds.title: Her Waise Choice
feeds.description: A Vancouver Personal Style Blog by Jen Tam who believes that you can be stylish without being superficial, on trend without being a slave to fashion, and look good without looking down on others.

feeds.title: Jen Pistor
feeds.description: I am Jen, a Fashion Blogger. I blog under my name and write about approachable styles for every woman, motherhood, kids, and life. I focus on content creation around slow fashion, secondhand shopping, and creative styling for the everyday. I hope to inspire fellow mommas to love the life they have and not obsess over the unobtainable.

feeds.title: Cara Jourdan
feeds.description: Cara Jourdan founded her blog as a creative outlet to share her thoughts, inspirations & personal style. She continues to share bits and pieces of her favorite things in life, from travel to fashion to lifestyle under Cara Jourdan. She is passionate about style and adventure and hopes to inspire her readers through chronicling all of the things she loves.

feeds.title: The Minted Mama Blog
feeds.description: I am a 30-something Mama with an eye for all things design. My blog features everything from fashion, beauty, lifestyle and more.

Sarah's personal story of beauty for ashes is at the core of her journey for helping women discover their magnificence and excel from within.

feeds.title: Jetset Justine

feeds.description: FASHION Magazine is singularly poised to bring the world of international fashion home to Canadians. With editors and contributors who travel to, and live in, the style capitals of the world, we're out there on the front lines of fashion.

feeds.description: Since 2013 The Blondielocks has been a destination for all things fashion, food, home, beauty & DIY. I'm here to help you to become inspired to 'Curate a life that is just right.'

feeds.title: My Curves And Curls

feeds.description: Barbara Ann is a twenty-something, fashion and style blogger, who spends her days working within the bridal industry, art directing and designing how Canadian couples plan their weddings and their registries.

feeds.title: Dolly's Dressing Room
feeds.description: Hi, I am Dolly Peel, I hope throughout my journey I will inspire you, not only through fashion and beauty, but on creating a lifestyle that is exactly what you want.

feeds.title: Something About That | Toronto Fashion And Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: My goal is to inspire others to be creative with how they get dressed each day. I believe that stylish outfits are within reach for anyone and that you don't have to spend a lot to look great each day! After all, I'm your average girl, with an average budget, and an average body.
